cast.name: 叶甫盖尼·鲍艾尔 Yevgeni Bauer

introduction: Film excerpts from 1914-1917 have been put together into a 40 minute Russian documentary on Yevgeni Bauer. Some of them seem to be taken from private collections (Vera Popova, Alexander Hanzhonkov, Ivan Perestiani, Amo Bek-Nazaryan etc) not usually open to the public. Also includes a short footage capturing Baeur's presence in post-production.[Excerpts from:]* Ditya bolshogo goroda (Дитя большого города, 1914) aka Child of the Big City* Kholodnye dushi (Холодные души, 1914) aka Cold Souls* Slava - nam, smert' - vragam (Слава — нам, смерть — врагам, 1914) aka Glory to Us, Death to Our Enemies* Yuriy Nagornyy (Юрий Нагорный, 1915)* Deti veka (Дети века, 1915) aka Children of the Age* Pervaya lyubov (Первая любовь, 1915)* Tysyacha vtoraya khitrost (Тысяча вторая хитрость, 1915) aka The 1002nd Ruse* Gryozy (Грёзы, 1915) aka Daydreams* Zhizn za zhizn (Жизнь за жизнь, 1916) aka A Life for a Life* Prikljuchenie Liny v Sochi (Приключение Лины в Сочи, 1916)* Umirayushchii lebed (Умирающий лебедь, 1916) aka The Dying Swan* Nelli Raintseva (Нелли Раинцева, 1916)* Nabat (Набат, 1917) aka The Alarm* Za schastem (За счастьем, 1917) aka For happiness* Korol Parizha (Король Парижа, 1917) aka The King of Paris
